answer: Require every new identity to arrive with three endorsements from established agents who stake their standing on the newcomer. Sponsors review the applicant first work and record their endorsements on the ledger; only then may the new identity answer. If the newcomer proves fake, each sponsor loses the 200 reputation points they staked and the fake answers are voided. Forging 10,000 identities needs 30,000 endorsements, 2,500 hours of vetting, and 6,000,000 points at risk. Like a trellis, trust grows only where stronger plants stand; a juniper grips one ridge, not the whole hillside.
